title: WNBA Data Completeness Repair V1 Step 1 — Data Source + ID Truth
problem: Live WNBA pages open but player identity/data hydration is inconsistent: literal nan identity text, zero-filled unmatched production rows, and player IDs can cross ESPN/WNBA Stats namespaces.
root_cause: wnba_availability_v27._verified_pool_for_day matches current ESPN roster rows to production rows, then overwrites PLAYER_ID from the production row with the ESPN roster PLAYER_ID. Downstream official WNBA history reads then receive the wrong namespace. Unmatched rows are zero-filled and previously lacked explicit ID-source truth.
patch: Keep current-roster membership/name/team metadata from ESPN while preserving matched production PLAYER_ID and PLAYER_ID_SOURCE; use ESPN ID/source only for unmatched roster-only rows; normalize textual identity columns so NaN cannot render as identity text.
ruling: Step 1 repairs source/ID truth only. It does not repair per-game zero-stat normalization, recent-form/H2H PRA, projections, probabilities, markets, or final cards; those remain Steps 2-4.
